propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer runs a single monolithic loop over 884 corpus units, each rendered twice (1768 pandoc spawns total), causing unbounded test cost: 91.6s idle, 504.8s under CPU saturation — 1.7x the 300s per-test timeout

pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the xdist worker without a traceback when per-test budget is exceeded, manifesting as 'node down: Not properly terminated' and worker crash on the macOS py3.13 CI lane
the test walks the entire committed corpus in one test function, so corpus growth extends wall-clock cost rather than adding test cases, causing the timeout to be structurally unbounded

the fix replaces the monolithic loop with chunk-parametrized test cases using _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40, reducing per-test cost to ~4.2s idle (7.9x headroom under timeout) and allowing xdist to parallelize
a new coverage guard test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit verifies all 884 units are compared and the total is >=100, preventing silent dropped units
all 884 units remain compared against the oracle with real pandoc, _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE stays 1, and no timeout raise or retry marker is added
